rules: Frames/process-window elapsed are used for FPS; completed guest intervals and published avg_fps are retained separately.
Independent counter drains and operations crossing boundaries prohibit exact per-frame attribution from these window histograms.
Process CPU during a shader call includes concurrent guest threads; it is not compiler-only CPU.
frame_latency is swap submission to observed completion in frame_context_cleanup, not a GPU timestamp or isolated GPU wait.
Texture/vertex/setup/flip are stage wall times over every eighth sampled frame; they are not all-frame CPU or GPU measurements.
Shader commit is nested in writer work; SPU read/object-load may overlap enclosing build; these totals must not be added as a serial critical path.
Fingerprint repeated_builds is a recent-64 lower bound; full keys are compared directly for the 32 captured long operations only.
Hex module handles are normalized from textual spelling, even when the previous generic parser stored digit-only hex as an integer.
The retained windows without SPU codegen still include 176 cache reads; their time cannot be subtracted from individual frames.
No baseline/candidate device comparison, new telemetry, shader dump, Core compilation, or FPS improvement is claimed.

window21Burst.caveat: Same-window burst association, not proven one-to-one frame mapping.
